page.notes: Doubtful: "n-surpavimus" (the word at the right column line end is uncertain; probably "usurpavimus" with a hyphen split from "non" or "nu-"). The left column runs past the cut, so its last entry is incomplete. "prasenti" was read as "prasenti" and may be a printing error for "præsenti". Blue underlines and number marks are digitiser highlighting and were not transcribed. The bottom-left fragment sits beside the lower lines of the right column but does not follow it alphabetically, so its placement relative to the right column is doubtful. Blue page references are copied as plain numbers.
